title: Normalized system tensor models and their reduction compatibility
statement: On the site and ring tower of [def-coef-semilinear-system-models], fix any SystemScalarCoherence of [lem-coef-semilinear-scalar-coherence]. This assertion contains no cartesian internal-Hom evaluation or Hom transition law.
